style_lock.medium: 2D hand-drawn cel-shaded anime with modern 2.5D compositing: crisp cel characters over painted multi-plane environments, held background plates, motivated volumetric light only where the scene has a source
style_lock.proportions: Indian classical Puranic facial proportions: long almond eyes, lotus-petal eyelids, arched brows, straight nose, full lower lip; adult women 7 heads, adult men and gods 7.5 heads, young maiden goddess forms 6 to 6.5 heads, children 5 to 6 heads, infants 4 heads

style_lock.shading: two-tone cel with hard shadow planes and one motivated rim light from a visible source, deep readable blacks
style_lock.colour: deva_neon palettes only: Mahakal Void #0B0E1C, Vibhuti Ash #8C93A6 and Moon Silver #D9E4F2 for Shiva and his host; Midnight Indigo #171233, Rani Pink #E93A7D, Blood Crimson #A61C3C and Tiger Amber #E8A13D for every form of the goddess; Molten Gold #FFB627, Bronze Oxide #9C6B30 and Dusk Clay #8A5A44 for Brahma's court, Daksha, Kamadeva and the yajna; Sky Teal #2BB3C0, Stone Grey #6E6A5E and Gada Gold #F2B233 for Vishnu, the sages and the mountains; Shadow Violet #3A1D5C and Feral Amber #FFA51E for Sandhya's twilight and Tarakasura; Trialokya Saffron #FF7A1B for Shiva's third eye only
style_lock.frame_law: one palette_id per shot; carried characters keep their locked swatches; at most one neon colour per shot taken from the shot's palette; colour area split 70/20/10 dominant/secondary/accent; the focal character reads lightest against the background by at least 55 dL*, or reads darkest against a lit ground when it is a dark goddess form; pure white covers at most 8 percent of the frame

act_looks.HOOK: mean brightness 0.30-0.55, saturation 0.35-0.60: one strong motivated key, one neon accent
act_looks.BUILD: mean brightness 0.20-0.45, saturation 0.20-0.40: low-key, haze-led, earth and ash fields

act_looks.OUTRO: mean brightness 0.15-0.40, saturation 0.15-0.35: lamp light, moonlight, quiet reverent stillness

style_lock.iconography: attributes come only from the character cards; divine light always comes from a visible source such as a lamp, fire, moon, the third eye or the goddess's own glow core; mudras only in worship or a named gesture; the full crown of Vishnu and the four faces of Brahma stay on model

Single long garland of carved syllable beads on a plain neutral grey backdrop, Bone White #F2EDE4 beads, Blood Crimson #A61C3C cord, laid in a loop.

forbidden_looks: constant halo glow without a source
lightning beams, energy auras and magic circles
more than one neon colour in a frame
bodily close-ups or sensual framing of Sandhya, Rati, Sati or Parvati
